name: Hesperian-Glen

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: They dwell in pressure-keeps beneath the ice, mining heat from the mantle seams.

description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a binary sunset emerge like the bones of the planet.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.
Around the temporal distortion zone, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
